_comment: Single source of review data for the whole site: the Reviews section on every page and the AggregateRating in the JSON-LD both read from here. Refresh from Google with: npm run reviews:refresh (then commit).

reviews.author: Katherine Gundel
reviews.text: We reached out to Bonet Plumbing to fix a DIY project. The owner Leo was super knowledgeable, professional and he worked with our busy schedule. We will definitely be calling Leo first for any future projects!

reviews.author: Danella Land Group
reviews.text: Leo is the only plumber I trust, not only with my own home but with my customers homes as well. He’s thorough and gets the job done right the first time. If you want a plumber you don’t have to second guess, I highly recommend Bonet Plumbing.

reviews.author: Michelle Espinal
reviews.text: Leo is super dependable! Super fast response and very fair pricing! Will always use Bonet plumbing for any plumbing issues in the future!
